question: Which of the following semi-solid pharmaceutical forms with which a master formula can be prepared has greater occlusivity ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Hydrophobic ointments -> greater occlusivity -> 80% CHAIN: Hydrophobic or water-oily creams -> moderate occlusivity -> 70% CHAIN: Hydrophilic or ole-aqueous creams -> lower occlusivity -> 60% CHAIN: Hydrophilic ointments -> least occlusivity -> 80%
analysis: Occlusivity refers to the ability of a semi-solid pharmaceutical form to create a barrier on the skin surface. Hydrophobic ointments typically have greater occlusivity compared to other forms due to their ability to form a thicker and more impermeable layer on the skin.
